changelog: Adds editable stable-ID AnimeThemes aliases with four verified fixes, normalized exact-match discovery, anime-library scoping, smaller miss payloads, targeted cache invalidation, and provider timing.
description: Finds missing TV series themes through ThemerrDB, library-aware strictly matched AnimeThemes openings or safe endings, and Plex, then saves normalized theme.mp3 files without overwriting existing themes.
name: Theme Music Finder
overview: Finds missing TV series theme music and saves it as theme.mp3.
